name: openemr-asr-demo
description: OpenEMR voice-to-text with a local clinical NLP pipeline.

scripts.check: npm run check:js && npm run check:py && npm run check:manifest && npm run test:py
scripts.check:js: node --check extension/content.js && node --check extension/scanner.js && node --check scripts/build-extension.mjs && node --check scripts/watch-extension.mjs
scripts.check:py: python3 -m py_compile asr/api.py asr/nlp/pipeline.py asr/nlp/medical.py asr/nlp/coding.py asr/nlp/phi.py asr/nlp/soap.py asr/nlp/asr_quality.py
